title: Nitid Studio models lock
description: Pinned, licence-audited list of the pretrained weights Studio may ever load or host. Structure only: the business rules (licence allowlist, pinned revision, hostable gate, unique ids) live in tools/check_models_lock.py. See docs/licensing/studio-weights.md.

generated_on.description: ISO date on which the facts in this file were last checked.

nitid_model.description: Public nitid name that resolves to this checkpoint (ADR-0004).

weights_variant.description: Variant name used by dfine/utils/downloads.py (for example coco, obj2coco).

format.description: Format of the pinned artefact. A derived ONNX file would be a separate entry with its own hash.

upstream_repo.description: Repository that publishes the code and states the licence.

revision.description: Pinned release tag, release id or commit. Floating names (main, master, latest, head) are rejected by the checker.

sha256_note.description: How and when the hash was obtained, or why it is missing.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the licence that covers the weights, as stated by the upstream source.

license_source.description: Exact place where the licence statement was read (file and revision, or API call).

open_caveats.description: Unresolved licence questions. Any item blocks hostable=true.

notice_files.description: Files that must travel with the weights (for example LICENSE, NOTICE). Must be non-empty when notice_required is true.

hostable.description: Result of the repository gate (see the checker), not a legal opinion: true means Studio is not blocked by this repository's rules from hosting a derived ONNX of this checkpoint.
